identifiedCourse.title: Final Sustainability Certification
identifiedCourse.applicableVersionPolicy: Standard curriculum version policy dictates that foundational courses created with compliant 80% passing threshold and comprehensive scenario-based assessment remain at Version 1 until a major curriculum restructuring occurs. Cohort remediation B through L upgraded 135 courses to Version 2 upon revising passing scores or authoring new option-level feedback.
identifiedCourse.reasonForVersion1: ELH-12 is the 15-question capstone certification exam across the 11 Core Sustainability courses (ELH-01..11). It was authored from inception with an 80% pass threshold (12/15 questions) and complete scenario depth. Because it was inherently compliant and was not a member of the modular remediation cohorts (B through L), its version remained at 1.
identifiedCourse.disposition: APPROVED_EXCEPTION — Version 1 is intentional, policy-compliant, and fully preserves learner certificate provenance.
